OpenAI's Codex lead announces global usage reset on day 6 of his pledge

Thibault Sottiaux posted "Day 6/ Reset" and promised a global reset by end of day, six days into his pledge to ship a daily Codex improvement or reset everyone's limits.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-codex-day-6-reset/

Yandex says a third data centre is shut after drone attack

Reuters reports Yandex shut a data centre near Vladimir after a drone attack, the third in four days. Two of the firm's three AI-model supercomputers are in Sasovo, hit on October 8.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-yandex-third-datacentre/
